title: walk.rs Option<&'a mut Vec<String>> correctly models RFC 8621 §4.1.4 nullable array refs
description: parse_structure() takes text_body and html_body as Option<&'a mut Vec<String>>. This models the RFC 8621 §4.1.4 JavaScript algorithm where textBody and htmlBody can be set to null to suppress further pushes. A contributor might suggest replacing this with a simpler boolean flag or a separate struct, but the Option<&mut Vec> pattern correctly handles both the nullification case (setting to None) and the cross-population at end-of-alternative (reading lengths at entry vs. exit). The current signature matches the RFC algorithm structure exactly.
